patterns.note: Content is consistently presented in narrow, centered columns, creating a focused reading experience with ample whitespace on the sides.
A distinctive pairing of an elegant, high-contrast script display font for major headings with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A predominantly light, warm off-white background is accented with muted, earthy tones and a vibrant, electric blue for calls to action.
Major content sections and grid items (projects, writings) reveal themselves with a staggered fade-up and slight vertical slide-in animation as they enter the viewport.
A small, hand-drawn-style wavy line graphic is consistently used as a whimsical visual separator between major content sections.

technique_notes: Content blocks and grid items animate into view using scroll-triggered reveals, typically a staggered fade-up combined with a subtle vertical translation, likely orchestrated with GSAP ScrollTrigger.
The main navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to navigation elements as the user scrolls.
The hero area features a dynamic, hand-drawn illustration style, potentially rendered using a canvas element for subtle animation or interactivity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant, high-contrast script headings (~2.5-3x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text; small uppercase labels are used for section introductions.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on cards and buttons, almost sharp).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections, balanced spacing within content blocks).

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a whimsical, hand-drawn illustration style with a sophisticated, minimalist layout creates a unique brand personality. The elegant script display font for headings further elevates this contrast, making the design feel both approachable and high-end.
